Hi Naomi,

Thanks for taking this. We’re working through our vendor assessment for platforms in scope for PHI processing and need a short package to complete the CAIQ review. Specifically can you provide: 

- CAIQ assertion index (mapping of your answers to CSA controls)
- Representative evidence extracts for the following control families: INF (network segmentation), LOG (telemetry retention/forwarding), CR (configuration & change tracking) — we only need small samples (log snippets, signed attestations, config diffs) not full exports.
- Point of contact and control owners for any controls where the assertion is partially compensating or relies on customer configuration.

Target timeline: can you confirm feasibility to deliver a packaged index + 3 sample extracts by EOD Thu (2026-12-09)? We may ask follow-ups but this will unblock our internal security sign-off.
